issues.issue: Was the Board's finding that Talavera was a member of Los Zetas, and so inadmissible under s 37(1)(a), reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Board erred in its reading of the evidence and of membership; no third-party evidence confirms membership and his PIF statement was misread.
issues.result_quote: Mr. Talavera has thus not persuaded me that the Board erred in finding that he was inadmissible to Canada.

issues.issue: Should the proposed question on proof of membership under s 37(1)(a) be certified?
issues.applicant_position: Proposed question: whether evidence of knowledge of some of the organization's activities is sufficient to prove membership.
issues.result_quote: This is not an appropriate question for certification, given that the membership finding in this case was based on more than mere knowledge
